date_text: Thu, Aug 6th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Aug 9th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Celebrate International IPA Day with us from midday Thursday as we tap 20 incredible beers from Australia and around the world. From crisp West Coast IPAs and juicy hazies to bold reds, dark ales and limited releases, they’re pouring until the keg runs dry.
